title: Ocean World: Eden Crafters Prologue
provenance: Reported by gerhardsmith84-bit (highball-db#922, 2026-11-02), Apple M4, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-crossover26.3-r29, DXMT, rated 1 of 5: the game never opens a window, its log reports GLFW_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE and WGL failing to create an OpenGL context, on Wine 10 r28 and Wine 11 r29 alike. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Does not start in one report on an M4. The game is built on libGDX with LWJGL3 and fails to get an OpenGL context.

knownIssues.symptom: Never opens a window, WGL fails to create an OpenGL context (GLFW_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed. Wine's Mac driver gives OpenGL 2.1, or 3.2 to 4.1 core, and refuses a 3.0 or 3.1 context, a compatibility one at 3.2 or above, and anything above 4.1, so the game most likely asks for one of those. Which version it asks for isn't known yet; a run with WINEDEBUG=fixme-all,warn+wgl would name it
